objective: Compare exact whole-evaluator affine hulls with access to private product outputs or checked quadratic combination on a fixed unsatisfiable family, with a satisfiable sign control and a path/star comparison.
status: Proved: Opposite checksums of a quadratic of polar rank 2r require exactly 2^r terminal cases using arbitrary public affine questions and the saturated affine hull of each whole evaluator. Product-visible cases on a path take linear numbers of leaves, and a degree-two proof bypasses the splits in linear size, even in a distributively regrouped control with no identical product gates.
title: Test affine case splitting on an actual inconsistent pair of evaluations
